input_access: durable STARTED before reading closed originals and the exact audited EG-COVERAGE-1 actual1 artifact; full invented run produces a new isolated predecessor fixture

events.population: one attempt per observed cluster in the authenticated coverage artifact; unavailable windows never reset an active cluster; preserve first-grid and other left-censored starts, branch failures and all original weeks
events.bar_clock: session-aligned 5m OHLC from complete original minutes; eligible at bar end plus two minutes; known missing or late required bar ends an attempt
events.A: positive signed 15m move and final 5m close above preceding two bars' maximum high K; first later lower close defines pullback; its low S must be strictly above K; first subsequent close above its high confirms while all intervening lows are at least S
events.B: negative signed 15m move and final 5m close below preceding two bars' minimum low K; breakdown bar low is S; first later close above K confirms while all intervening lows are at least S
events.structural_priority: within a candidate confirmation bar, low below frozen S invalidates before a confirming close
events.entry: next minute open after confirmation decision, with strict S < observed open < P + 2*(P-S); outside bracket is a retained refusal
events.immediate_control: all observed clusters, at first high decision plus one minute; fixed 30m endpoint; never condition its original admission on future A/B confirmation

observations.entry_and_hold_chart: 60 fixed minute slots with latest15 observed prices required, explicit preopening, missing and observed masks; normalized OHLC and volume features from the available prefix only
observations.peer: same original S1/S2 date roster excluding target, at least four peers with complete latest15 price; earlier aggregates retain original denominator and known-only cohort counts
observations.common_support: chart and peer at the same causal decision plus supported primary clock; no use of future entry price or results for support; chart-only wider evaluation separately
observations.streams: same ordered event keys in separate predecision feature and result frames; feature footer carries event count only

labels.outside_clock: exit must precede original session close minus 15 minutes
labels.primary_value: fixed horizon open / admitted entry open - 1, gross; first touch retained separately
labels.first_touch: at or beyond either barrier at minute open resolves order; open inside both and both extrema touch means unknown order; a preceding unknown minute prevents adjudicating later first touch
labels.target_first_probability: known target first is one; known stop first or time is zero; tie, gap and refused entry are missing targets
labels.holding_value: (fixed cap open - next exit open) / original entry open; maturity requires all used observations; retain early exit quote even if cap is unavailable
labels.quote_scope: retrospective stored prices; no contact assumed to be a broker fill
labels.cutoff: original session close for stored labels; native fits additionally require maturity strictly before first evaluation open

model_comparison_plan.folds: existing fixed 257-session five expanding chronological splits; train only common supported candidates; retain all original evaluation coordinates
model_comparison_plan.fits: one per learned arm per A/B per S1/S2 per fold, at most 60 total; no learned calibration fit
model_comparison_plan.lgb: fixed existing numeric LightGBM parameters on tagged task rows and chart summaries; one regression fit; clip target-first score to [0,1] and retain raw score
model_comparison_plan.tcn: CPU deterministic FP32 causal minute tower, chart width 12 and chart plus peer width 18, masked MSE/BCE three-head fit; reuse EF seed base plus fold, 6 epochs, 128 batch, AdamW and gradient norm 1
model_comparison_plan.calibration: fixed five reliability bins and Brier losses versus the fold training prevalence on the same known outcome pairs
model_comparison_plan.management: clone one paid entry lot; structural close failure exits, first nonpositive expected hold advantage requests half and a consecutive nonpositive update exits the remainder; unknown stays explicit; remaining inventory exits at fixed cap
model_comparison_plan.model_release: each fit, comparison and management unit needs a separate closed runtime registration and its own review and qualification

qualification: exact reviewed release and runtime, whole invented original geometry, independent reconstruction, durable completed lifecycle and separate original-receipt audit before actual label access
